all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَٱلَّٰٓـِٔي يَئِسۡنَ مِنَ ٱلۡمَحِيضِ مِن نِّسَآئِكُمۡ إِنِ ٱرۡتَبۡتُمۡ فَعِدَّتُهُنَّ ثَلَٰثَةُ أَشۡهُرࣲ وَٱلَّٰٓـِٔي لَمۡ يَحِضۡنَۚ وَأُوْلَٰتُ ٱلۡأَحۡمَالِ أَجَلُهُنَّ أَن يَضَعۡنَ حَمۡلَهُنَّۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يَجۡعَل لَّهُۥ مِنۡ أَمۡرِهِۦ يُسۡرࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: And those who no longer expect menstruation among your women - if you doubt, then their period is three months, and [also for] those who have not menstruated. And for those who are pregnant, their term is until they give birth. And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him of his matter ease.
translations.pickthall: And for such of your women as despair of menstruation, if ye doubt, their period (of waiting) shall be three months, along with those who have it not. And for those with child, their period shall be till they bring forth their burden. And whosoever keepeth his duty to Allah, He maketh his course easy for him.
translations.khattab: As for your women past the age of menstruation, in case you do not know, their waiting period is three months, and those who have not menstruated as well. As for those who are pregnant, their waiting period ends with delivery. And whoever is mindful of Allah, He will make their matters easy for them
translations.arberry: As for your women who have despaired of further menstruating, if you are in doubt, their period shall be three months; and those who have not menstruated as yet. And those who are with child, their term is when they bring forth their burden. Whoso fears God, God will appoint for him, of His command, easiness.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَسۡكِنُوهُنَّ مِنۡ حَيۡثُ سَكَنتُم مِّن وُجۡدِكُمۡ وَلَا تُضَآرُّوهُنَّ لِتُضَيِّقُواْ عَلَيۡهِنَّۚ وَإِن كُنَّ أُوْلَٰتِ حَمۡلࣲ فَأَنفِقُواْ عَلَيۡهِنَّ حَتَّىٰ يَضَعۡنَ حَمۡلَهُنَّۚ فَإِنۡ أَرۡضَعۡنَ لَكُمۡ فَـَٔاتُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ وَأۡتَمِرُواْ بَيۡنَكُم بِمَعۡرُوفࣲۖ وَإِن تَعَاسَرۡتُمۡ فَسَتُرۡضِعُ لَهُۥٓ أُخۡرَىٰ

translations.saheeh: Lodge them [in a section] of where you dwell out of your means and do not harm them in order to oppress them. And if they should be pregnant, then spend on them until they give birth. And if they breastfeed for you, then give them their payment and confer among yourselves in the acceptable way; but if you are in discord, then there may breastfeed for the father another woman.
translations.pickthall: Lodge them where ye dwell, according to your wealth, and harass them not so as to straiten life for them. And if they are with child, then spend for them till they bring forth their burden. Then, if they give suck for you, give them their due payment and consult together in kindness; but if ye make difficulties for one another, then let some other woman give suck for him (the father of the child).
translations.khattab: Let them live where you live ˹during their waiting period˺, according to your means. And do not harass them to make their stay unbearable. If they are pregnant, then maintain them until they deliver. And if they nurse your child, compensate them, and consult together courteously. But if you fail to reach an agreement, then another woman will nurse ˹the child˺ for the father
translations.arberry: Lodge them where you are lodging, according to your means, and do not press them, so as to straiten their circumstances. If they are with child, expend upon them until they bring forth their burden. If they suckle for you, give them their wages, and consult together honourably. If you both make difficulties, another woman shall suckle for him.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَعَدَّ ٱللَّهُ لَهُمۡ عَذَابࣰ ا شَدِيدࣰ اۖ فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ يَٰٓأُوْلِي ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْۚ قَدۡ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَيۡكُمۡ ذِكۡرࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: Allah has prepared for them a severe punishment; so fear Allah, O you of understanding who have believed. Allah has sent down to you the Qur'an.
translations.pickthall: Allah hath prepared for them stern punishment; so keep your duty to Allah, O men of understanding! O ye who believe! Now Allah hath sent down unto you a reminder,
translations.khattab: Allah has ˹also˺ prepared for them a severe punishment. So fear Allah, O people of reason and faith. Allah has indeed revealed to you a Reminder
translations.arberry: God prepared for them a terrible chastisement. So fear God, O men possessed of minds! Believers, God has sent down to you, for a remembrance,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ

translations.saheeh: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."
translations.pickthall: That, when Our revelations are recited unto him, he saith: Mere fables of the men of old.
translations.khattab: whenever Our revelations are recited to him, he says, “Ancient fables!”
translations.arberry: When Our signs are recited to him, he says, 'Fairy-tales of the ancients!'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَذَرۡنِي وَٱلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ أُوْلِي ٱلنَّعۡمَةِ وَمَهِّلۡهُمۡ قَلِيلًا

translations.saheeh: And leave Me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little.
translations.pickthall: Leave Me to deal with the deniers, lords of ease and comfort (in this life); and do thou respite them awhile.
translations.khattab: And leave to Me the deniers—the people of luxury—and bear with them for a little while
translations.arberry: Leave Me to those who cry lies, those prosperous ones, and respite them a little,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَلَمۡ نُهۡلِكِ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ

translations.saheeh: Did We not destroy the former peoples?
translations.pickthall: Destroyed We not the former folk,
translations.khattab: Did We not destroy earlier disbelievers
translations.arberry: Did We not destroy the ancients,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: هَٰذَا يَوۡمُ ٱلۡفَصۡلِۖ جَمَعۡنَٰكُمۡ وَٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ

translations.saheeh: This is the Day of Judgement; We will have assembled you and the former peoples.
translations.pickthall: This is the Day of Decision, We have brought you and the men of old together.
translations.khattab: ˹They will be told by Allah,˺ “This is the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision: We have gathered you along with earlier disbelievers ˹for punishment˺
translations.arberry: 'This is the Day of Decision; We have joined you with the ancients;

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَأَخَذَهُ ٱللَّهُ نَكَالَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ وَٱلۡأُولَىٰٓ

translations.saheeh: So Allah seized him in exemplary punishment for the last and the first [transgression].
translations.pickthall: So Allah seized him (and made him) an example for the after (life) and for the former.
translations.khattab: So Allah overtook him, making him an example in this life and the next
translations.arberry: So God seized him with the chastisement of the Last World and the First.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ

translations.saheeh: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."
translations.pickthall: Who, when thou readest unto him Our revelations, saith: (Mere) fables of the men of old.
translations.khattab: Whenever Our revelations are recited to them, they say, “Ancient fables!”
translations.arberry: When our signs are recited to him, he says, 'Fairy-tales of the ancients!'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَفِي ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلۡأُولَىٰ

translations.saheeh: Indeed, this is in the former scriptures,
translations.pickthall: Lo! This is in the former scrolls.
translations.khattab: This is certainly ˹mentioned˺ in the earlier Scriptures—
translations.arberry: Surely this is in the ancient scrolls,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلۡأٓخِرَةَ وَٱلۡأُولَىٰ

translations.saheeh: And indeed, to Us belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].
translations.pickthall: And lo! unto Us belong the latter portion and the former.
translations.khattab: And surely to Us ˹alone˺ belong this life and the next
translations.arberry: and to Us belong the Last and the First.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَلَلۡأٓخِرَةُ خَيۡرࣱ لَّكَ مِنَ ٱلۡأُولَىٰ

translations.saheeh: And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life].
translations.pickthall: And verily the latter portion will be better for thee than the former,
translations.khattab: And the next life is certainly far better for you than this one
translations.arberry: and the Last shall be better for thee than the First.
